dict.string: MOI reads track information and controls your selected Spotify or Apple Music player after you connect it.
moi shows your next event in the notch, if you turn on the Calendar part. Events stay on this Mac.
moi looks at your Desktop only when you ask it to tidy, or to show your newest screenshots in the notch. It moves files into folders and never deletes them.
moi shows your newest downloads in the notch so you can drag them where they need to go. It doesn't change or upload them.
MOI captures microphone audio only when you explicitly start push-to-talk. Recognition is required to stay on-device.
moi looks through your photos only when you ask it to find some (like “flowers” or “trip in Italy”). It can make an album of them; it never changes or deletes your photos.
MOI converts your deliberate push-to-talk audio into a visible transcript using an available on-device recognizer.
